result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue in the 'Fastest near you' carousel where the middle restaurant card is vertically misaligned.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is shifted downward and out of vertical alignment with the adjacent 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola' cards.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent top alignment and remove any extra top margin or padding on the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card so all items in the carousel row align evenly.
